statements.impact_statement: The v0.13.0 reference is unused upstream module metadata embedded beside the vendored logrus source. The compatibility runtime builds in GOPATH vendor mode against the exact golang.org/x/sys v0.47.0 source recorded in runtime/nfs/go.mod, so v0.13.0 is not present in the product. The affected NewNTUnicodeString symbol is Windows-only, while all three maintained storage runtime images are Linux binaries. A Go 1.27 binary-mode govulncheck scan reports zero vulnerabilities.
